name: Wizard Links
source:
Hikaru is a normal student, who lives with her parents and younger brother. One day, she had a shocking encounter with a strange girl with blonde hair and blue eyes, Elena, who was a magician who had been sent to hunt ‘devils’. Hikaru’s daily life greatly changed as she was dragged into their intense battles.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/04/01/april-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
